description: This file declares the MiscService class, which is part of a modem simulator in the cuttlefish project. It provides methods for handling IMEI retrieval, time updates, and timezone management, and includes necessary headers and namespace usage.

classes.name: MiscService
classes.description: A class that extends ModemService to provide miscellaneous services such as IMEI handling, time updates, and timezone management within the modem simulator.

methods.name: HandleGetIMEI
methods.description: Handles the retrieval of the IMEI number for a client.

methods.name: HandleTimeUpdate
methods.description: Handles time update requests from a client.

methods.name: SetTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the timezone for the service.

methods.name: ParseTimeZone
methods.description: Parses the timezone string to update internal state.

methods.name: TimeZoneOffset
methods.description: Calculates the timezone offset in seconds based on the provided UTC time.

methods.name: FixTimeZone
methods.description: Adjusts or formats the timezone line.

methods.name: InitializeCommandHandlers
methods.description: Initializes command handlers for the service.
